title: The delivery route of a match to rwb-treatment, the plan-position elements and the payment frequency of a plan are not specified for the S2 slice of RWB-E2-008

description: One combined row for the treatment slice of the payment key. (1) The route of the match to the plan is not one route in the sources: the legacy story has rwb-treatment expose TreatmentApi.recordInstallmentPaid and rwb-payment call it in the same step, Temporal and Drools Design slide 9 has rwb-payment publish PaymentMissed (EV-12) and rwb-case route it to TreatmentWorkflow, and slide 42 lists rwb-treatment among the consumers of that event; no source states whether the matched installment reaches the plan as a REST write, as ProceedsMatched (EV-25) or as both, and the legacy operation has no name, no payload and no entry in TSD S2 T-A.1. (2) The plan position has no column of its own: TSD S2 T3.1 carries first_due_date (DF-TRT-029), installments (DF-TRT-009), installment_amount (DF-TRT-031), installments_paid (DF-TRT-032) and installment_shortfall (DF-TRT-033) and no next due date, no missed due date and no missed amount, so the position the case owner must see can only be derived or be an element of an answer, and no source names that element or says whether it is stored, returned or computed. (3) The payment frequency of a plan is not a field anywhere: the legacy plan of 12,500.00 THB a month over 24 installments with due dates 2026-12-15 and 2027-01-15 is monthly by its values, TSD S2 T4 sets PLAN_RUNNING on SCHEDULE_SET (R-RES-25), and no source carries a frequency column or a frequency list from which a code could read it. (4) The plan-position rule is not attributed: the package list of the context pack names RESTRUCTURE and PAYMENT_MATCH as the Phase 1 packages of S2, while no source says which package version decided the advance of an installment on the plan, and the legacy story names only the PAYMENT_MATCH version PM-2026.12 and rule R-RES-26. (5) The two consumer groups, the two activity names and the flag name of this slice are named by no source, and the legacy job name JOB-07 belongs to rwb-payment.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E2-008 section 12 (published interfaces called: void TreatmentApi.recordInstallmentPaid(UUID treatmentId, UUID proceedsId, LocalDate dueDate, BigDecimal amount)) and section 13 (package recovery.payments.matching, V2_008__payment_matching.sql); Temporal and Drools Design slide 9 notes 2 and 3 (rwb-payment publishes PaymentMissed; the case router signals CaseWorkflow which passes it to TreatmentWorkflow) and slide 11 (one queue per service); Architecture v5 slide 42 (rwb-treatment among the consumers of event 12) and slide 43; TSD S2 v2 T3.1 (no next-due-date, missed-date, missed-amount or frequency field) and T-A.1 (four treatment operations, none for an installment); FSD S2 v3 A2.10.3.1 (R-RES-22, R-RES-25) and A2.11.3.1 (R-RES-29, R-RES-30) with no frequency value; context pack S2 (Tables (1) treatment; REST operations provided (4); Events (1) EV-10; Workflows (1) TreatmentWorkflow)
area: rwb-treatment / treatment record and plan position / payment match and missed payment
owner_role: Tech lead of rwb-treatment with the P8 rwb-payment owner, the P3 rwb-case owner and the P7 rwb-decision package owner at the wave 2 contract freeze
proposed: Build the plan position from the columns the TSD already carries, apply the match reported on rwb.payment.ProceedsMatched.v1 and the miss reported on rwb.payment.PaymentMissed.v1 of RWB-P8-E2008-CON through the inbox of this service, name the two activities applyProceedsMatched and holdMissedInstallment, and serve the position as elements of the treatment read of API-S2-002; confirm the package and the frequency at the contract freeze. RWB-P8-E2008-APP keeps the match, the row order, the exception list, JOB-07 and the ten legacy criteria.
